propositions: The host updater script currently bypasses the committed uv.lock by using unlocked pipx VCS resolution, defeating the Click 8.4.2 security override and dependency constraints.
The updater must check out an exact SHA returned by git ls-remote and run uv sync --locked --no-dev with runtime/operator extras instead of pipx VCS installation.
Sync or smoke failures must leave the current installation byte-identical and log rejection status, ensuring safe rollback on any build phase failure.
The updater must atomically publish only the successful release candidate and remove rejected or superseded releases from the updater-managed state directory.
Symbolic links (rebar, rebar-mcp, last-good.sha) must resolve through the versioned current directory to maintain stable references across updates.
A launchd-triggered update must exit cleanly, verify Click 8.4.2 is present, pass pip-audit without PYSEC-2026-2132, and log no-op on subsequent immediate runs.
